question: Did Blake book Adan Dinning?
qmask: Did [customer name] book [store name]?
sql:
SELECT B.Booking_ID, C.Customer_Name, S.Store_Name, B.Status_Code
FROM Bookings B
INNER JOIN Customers C ON B.Customer_ID = C.Customer_ID
INNER JOIN Stores S ON B.Store_ID = S.Store_ID
WHERE C.Customer_Name = 'Blake' AND S.Store_Name = 'Adan Dinning'

question: How many bookings does each customer have?
qmask: How many bookings does each customer have?
sql:
SELECT C.Customer_Name, COUNT(B.Booking_ID) AS booking_count
FROM Customers C
LEFT JOIN Bookings B ON C.Customer_ID = B.Customer_ID
GROUP BY C.Customer_Name
ORDER BY booking_count DESC

question: Which customer has the most bookings?
qmask: Which customer has the most bookings?
sql:
SELECT C.Customer_Name, COUNT(B.Booking_ID) AS booking_count
FROM Customers C
INNER JOIN Bookings B ON C.Customer_ID = B.Customer_ID
GROUP BY C.Customer_Name
ORDER BY booking_count DESC
LIMIT 1
